change_interpretations.engineering_summary: The maximum allowable driver torque response time for pedal demand >70% was reduced from 100 ms to 80 ms, requiring updated script thresholds and re-testing where prior results exceed 80 ms.

assessments.reason: The requirement response time limit tightened from 100 ms to 80 ms. Previous PASS result of 94 ms fails the new 80 ms limit, and the test script procedure still references a 100 ms threshold.
assessments.recommended_action: Update the procedure threshold to 80 ms and rerun the test on the new build.

assessments.reason: The test directly verifies torque response at 85% pedal demand under VCU-DR-01, but previous evidence did not report response timing to verify compliance with the new 80 ms limit.
evidence: comment: Timing not reported in old evidence
assessments.recommended_action: Rerun the test procedure while capturing explicit torque response timing.

assessments.reason: The test measures pedal demand response times (75-95% pedal) with a recorded 92 ms, which exceeds the tightened 80 ms limit of VCU-DR-01, but the requirement link was lost during migration.
evidence: workshop note: High-load campaign did not keep all requirement hyperlinks
assessments.recommended_action: Update test tolerance to 80 ms and rerun test after restoring requirement link.

assessments.reason: This test verifies emergency brake actuator latency under VCU-BRK-03, which uses a different measurement clock from driver torque response per workshop notes.
evidence: workshop note: Brake command latency and positive torque command latency are measured by different clocks
assessments.recommended_action: No action required for this specification change.

assessments.reason: Verifies wheel-speed sensor failure response under VCU-DGN-04, which is unchanged.
Verifies mode change logging under VCU-LOG-05, which is unchanged.
The procedure uses 80% pedal demand, touching VCU-DR-01, but the requirement link is TBD, the test has not been run, and ownership is unassigned.
evidence: comment: Ownership and source link to be clarified
assessments.recommended_action: Have the human owner clarify requirement mapping, ownership, and scope before executing.

assessments.reason: Verifies legacy diagnostic replay, which is unrelated to accelerator pedal torque response times.
evidence: comment: Imported row; requirements catalog changed
assessments.recommended_action: No action needed for VCU-DR-01 change.

assessments.reason: Verifies qualitative torque ramp profile differences under unchanged requirement VCU-MOD-06 without quantitative response time assertions.
Verifies transient pedal pulse filtering under unchanged requirement VCU-DR-02.
Verifies brake override torque cancellation under unchanged requirement VCU-BRK-03.
Verifies ECU platform power cycle startup time, unrelated to driver torque response.
